g: Give an Approximate Amount with 多
Say What Changed from Before with 本來 (原來) … 後來 …

s: 爸爸這幾天背很疼，看了兩次病了，還是不舒服。
Bàba zhè jǐ tiān bèi hěn téng, kànle liǎng cì bìng le, háishì bù shūfu.
Dad's back has been hurting these few days; he has seen the doctor twice, but he is still uncomfortable.
我去醫院看完病後，醫生給了我一張單子去櫃檯付錢和領藥。
Wǒ qù yīyuàn kàn wán bìng hòu, yīshēng gěi le wǒ yī zhāng dānzi qù guìtái fù qián hé lǐng yào.
After I finished seeing the doctor at the hospital, the doctor gave me a form to go to the counter to pay and pick up medicine.
